### New

**Schematic color themes (KiCad style)**
- Theme selector in the schematic toolbar: **Altium (original)** + 6 light (KiCad default, wLight, Solarized Light, Nord, Blue Tone, Black/White) + 5 dark (Solarized Dark, wDark, Behave Dark, Monokai, Eagle Dark).
- Colors follow the object type: wire, bus, junction, pin, pin name / number, component outline and fill, designator, value, net label, port, sheet symbol, no-ERC, sheet frame.
- The choice is remembered in the browser; in the combined view the selector sits in the top bar.
- With "Altium (original)" the drawing is identical to the previous version.
- Themes: KiCad 10 "KiCad Default" and [pointhi/kicad-color-schemes](https://github.com/pointhi/kicad-color-schemes) (CC0).

**Zoom to net**
- Clicking a net in the Nets list (or Enter in search) zooms the schematic to that net's labels and centers them; the labels are marked with a short ring.
- Clicking a sheet name in the net strip at the bottom zooms to the net on that sheet.
- Shift+click (add to comparison) and clicking a net name on the schematic do not move the view.

### Known limitation
- Images embedded in the schematic (logo, datasheet picture) are not recolored; they stay white on dark themes.
